subject.title: [Feature]: Align on macOS remote Gateway UX before broader PRs

question: What macOS Remote Gateway trust and lifecycle boundary should contributors implement next for discovery-assisted setup, remote diagnostics, and reset/restart controls?
rationale: The remaining work can expose or act on remote Gateway state, unauthenticated discovery hints, and SSH or service lifecycle controls, so automation cannot choose the product/security policy safely.

options.title: Approve split PRs with explicit boundaries
options.body: Proceed with focused PRs that keep TXT as hints only, use authenticated remote diagnostics, and make reset/reconnect/restart actions mode-specific and auditable.

options.title: Limit scope to tunnel hardening for now
options.body: Treat the landed orphan cleanup and open PortGuardian follow-up as the only near-term implementation while deferring discovery and lifecycle UX.

options.title: Pause broader Remote UX changes
options.body: Keep current docs/manual setup and require a maintainer-owned design before any new native UI or RPC surface lands.

recommendation.title: Approve split PRs with explicit boundaries
recommendation.body: Proceed with focused PRs that keep TXT as hints only, use authenticated remote diagnostics, and make reset/reconnect/restart actions mode-specific and auditable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and open work on system.info, macOS remote diagnostics, and PortGuardian makes this the clearest routing candidate from current history.
